senses.definition: The ratio of the probability of an event happening to that of it not happening.
examples: I'd say the odds are strongly in favor of the sun rising tomorrow morning.

senses.definition: The ratio of winnings to stake in betting situations.
examples: I looked at the odds given by all bookmakers.

senses.definition: (chess) An advantage given to a weaker opponent in order to equalize the game when playing casually, usually by removing one of the stronger player's pieces or by giving the weaker player more time.
examples: She beat me with knight odds but lost with rook odds.
The grandmaster gave his opponents significant time odds, of one minute versus ten minutes.

quotes.text: Nowadays, giving material odds in this way is rather rare, but the advent of the chess clock has made it possible for strong players to give time odds — taking one or two minutes for all their moves, for example, and allowing their opponents five minutes or more.
